claims.text: The Pentagon confirmed in April 2019 that it was ending the JASON advisory contract, which was managed by MITRE and run through the Office of the Under Secretary of Defense for Research and Engineering.

edges.label: NNSA rescued and now sponsors JASON after DoD declined renewal
edges.note: On 25-26 April 2019 NNSA issued a notice of intent to award a short-term sole source contract to MITRE for JASON management and logistics support, two weeks after OUSD(R&E) confirmed it was ending the contract.

topics.title: Atomic secrecy and the weapons laboratories
